content: {"like": ["Script by Mark Gatiss condenses over three years into a tight, engaging narrative", "Casting of David Bradley as William Hartnell, Jessica Raine as Verity Lambert, Sacha Dhawan as Waris Hussein, Brian Cox as Sydney Newman, and a strong supporting cast", "Production values with detailed recreations of early Doctor Who sets, costumes, and props, including the original TARDIS console room", "Authentic recreation of 1960s settings such as the Hartnell home and BBC TV Centre", "Overall tribute to the people who launched Doctor Who, delivered with love and attention to detail"], "dislike": ["Running time limits the film’s ability to give everyone their due", "Occasional sweeping generalizations in the storytelling", "Some casting choices were less successful, notably Reece Shearsmith as Patrick Troughton"]}
